title: News Surprises
caption:
You did everything right, and then the price dropped out of nowhere.

Usually it wasn't nowhere. It was a scheduled release: inflation, jobs, rates or earnings. And it's the surprise against the forecast that moves the price.

Meme Street has an economy calendar with forecasts, earnings every couple of days and a live news wire, so you can practise trading around them.

Practise trading the news at memestreet.net

Fictional market. Not investment advice.

narration: You did everything right, and then the price dropped out of nowhere. Usually, it wasn't nowhere. It was a scheduled release, like inflation, jobs, interest rates or earnings.
